status: AWAITING APPROVAL — artwork and new creature mechanics only; not in runtime roster

concepts.evolution: Snubling evolves at Lv. 32. Two stages.
concepts.ability: Ugly Rebuke — contact moves damage the attacker. Proposed retaliation: 1/8 of the attacker’s maximum HP per successful contact hit.
moves: 32 · Gravel Gape (proposed Rock special signature, 90 power)
concepts.description: A cute, decidedly ugly goblin-shark pup becomes a long-snouted predator with a projecting jaw and jagged stone armour. Both remain sharks, with strong readable eyes.

concepts.evolution: Narlit → Auracorn at Lv. 22; Auracorn → Oraclespear at Lv. 40. Three stages.
concepts.ability: Sage Mind — damaging special attacks have double power and lose secondary effects. Status, flinch and stat-change side effects attached to those attacks are removed; standalone status moves remain available.
moves: 40 · Oracle Ray (proposed Psychic special signature, 90 power)
concepts.description: A round narwhal calf develops flowing psychic fins, then becomes an imposing elder with a crystal spear-tusk, spectral beard and psychic crown.

concepts.evolution: No evolution. Normal form and Sun God’s Wrath form are the same Abyssal.
concepts.ability: Sun God's Wrath — transforms when HP falls below half, with separate artwork and boosts to all stats. Proposed tuning: all six stats ×1.25, including maximum HP while preserving the current HP fraction; one transformation per battle, lasting until that battle ends. Permanent growth is unchanged.
moves: 40 · Solar Flare (proposed Fire special signature, 95 power)
concepts.description: A broad, flattened ocean sunfish with pale gold fins erupts into a molten solar form. The same face and silhouette remain recognisable beneath its fiery corona.

concepts.evolution: Finlet → Reeftalon at Lv. 18; Reeftalon → Tideryu at Lv. 36. Three stages.
concepts.ability: Slipstream Discipline — every successful resisted damaging hit raises Speed by two stages, subject to the normal +6 cap. Neutral, super-effective and immune hits do not trigger it.
concepts.description: A friendly little ray becomes an athletic martial manta, then a sweeping ocean warrior with luminous wing-edge blades. Its body remains aquatic rather than humanoid.

concepts.evolution: Chitin Core on Rivet at Lv. 12+ → Carapex; Carapex → Elytrarch at Lv. 36.
concepts.ability: Warbond — retains the shared Rivet ability: double EXP for all participants, including binocular participants.
moves: 36 · Prayer Reap (proposed Bug physical signature, 85 power)
concepts.description: The approved bronze Rivet starter stays unchanged. The new armour becomes lean praying-mantis machinery in emerald, pearl white, silver and magenta, with triangular insect faces and jointed grasping scythes. The Chitin Core is an emerald mantis egg-heart held in pale metal claws.
